test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian States is famous for Paika dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Paika Naach or Paika Nritya** is a well-known **Orissan dancing style** from the **Khurda district.**
 
• It is an intense dance performance that calls for a lot of vigour and energy.
 
• It has been a staple of Orissa since the dawn of time and is now an integral component of the state's well-known celebrations.
 
• The Paika dance, performed by the** Munda tribe in the Jharkhand region of Mayurbhanj, is well-known.**
 
• It is a distinctive folk dance that embodies martial arts.
 
• The dance plays a significant role in weddings, Dussehra, and numerous other festivities.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Odissi **is one of the most well-known Indian classical dance forms, along with** Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, Kathak, Kathakali, and Manipuri.**
 
• It is indigenous to Orissa in eastern India and adheres to the Natya-tenets. shastra's Odissi emphasises sinuous postures and is energized by various heights and hops, sharing a basic pattern with Bharatanatyam. It is primarily a female dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
